intent.raw_query: Nepal trekking Annapurna, $2000 solo, October 2026, 14 days

selected_hotel.name: Annapurna Sanctuary, Annapurna Conservation Area Boutique Stay

experiences.name: Annapurna Base Camp Trek
experiences.description: A classic 10-14 day trek through diverse landscapes including rhododendron forests, terraced fields, and high-altitude glacial moraines, culminating at Annapurna Base Camp at 4,130m with breathtaking 360-degree views of the Annapurna massif.

experiences.name: Poon Hill Sunrise Hike
experiences.description: A rewarding hike to Poon Hill viewpoint at 3,210m to witness a spectacular sunrise over the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges. The golden light illuminating the snow-capped peaks is one of Nepal's most iconic natural experiences.
experiences.location: Ghorepani, Poon Hill, Annapurna Conservation Area

experiences.name: Mardi Himal Trek
experiences.description: A less-crowded alternative trekking route through dense forests of oak and rhododendron, alpine meadows, and dramatic ridgelines leading to Mardi Himal Base Camp at 4,500m with stunning close-up views of Machhapuchhre (Fishtail Mountain).
experiences.location: Mardi Himal, Eastern Annapurna Conservation Area

experiences.name: Gurung Village Cultural Homestay & Nature Walk
experiences.description: Stay with a local Gurung family in a traditional stone village, participate in daily life, enjoy authentic dal bhat meals, and join a guided nature walk through terraced farmland and subtropical forests to learn about local flora, fauna, and Himalayan ecology.
experiences.location: Ghandruk Village, Modi Khola Valley, Annapurna Conservation Area

experiences.name: Birethanti to Tikhedhunga Riverside Trail Hike
experiences.description: A scenic introductory hike along the Modi Khola river valley through lush subtropical vegetation, cascading waterfalls, and traditional Nepali villages. Ideal for acclimatization and immersing in the natural beauty of the lower Annapurna foothills before ascending higher.
experiences.location: Birethanti to Tikhedhunga, Modi Khola Valley, Annapurna Region

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Annapurna, Nepal
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Annapurna Sanctuary, Annapurna Conservation Area Boutique Stay

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Clear immigration and customs, collect luggage, exchange currency at the airport money exchange counter for best rates. Take a pre-paid taxi or local bus to Thamel (Kathmandu's budget traveler hub). Check into a budget guesthouse (~$8–12/night). Rest and freshen up. Walk around Thamel to gather trekking permits, maps, and supplies.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll through Thamel's lively streets. Visit a local gear shop to rent or buy any missing trekking equipment. Enjoy a simple dinner at a local dal bhat restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Skip or grab a snack at the airport
meals.lunch: Grab a quick meal at a Kathmandu local canteen near Thamel (~$2–3)
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat set meal at a local Thamel restaurant like OR2K or a street-side bhoj ghar (~$4–6)

day_by_day.notes: Obtain your TIMS (Trekkers' Information Management System) card and ACAP (Annapurna Conservation Area Permit) the following morning. TIMS costs ~$20 and ACAP costs ~$30. Keep USD or NPR ready. Rest well for early departure next day.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning visit to the Nepal Tourism Board office in Kathmandu to obtain TIMS card and ACAP permit. Then head to the Kathmandu bus park (Gongabu) and take a tourist or local bus to Pokhara (7–8 hours, ~$5–8 tourist bus or $3 local bus). Depart by 7:00–8:00 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive in Pokhara by mid-afternoon. Check into a lakeside budget guesthouse near Phewa Lake (~$8–12/night). Freshen up and stroll along Lakeside Road (Baidam). Visit a trekking outfitter to confirm gear, buy snacks, and finalize route planning.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the sunset over Phewa Lake with views of the Annapurna range. Enjoy dinner at a lakeside local restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Simple bread, eggs, and tea at Thamel guesthouse (~$2)
meals.lunch: Packed snacks or a quick stop at a roadside dhaba during the bus journey (~$2)
meals.dinner: Thakali set meal or momos at a local Pokhara restaurant (~$4–6)

day_by_day.notes: Book a local jeep or bus to Nayapul or Phedi for the next morning. Confirm departure time with your guesthouse. Pack light — leave non-essential items at the guesthouse storage (usually free or $1/day).

day_by_day.morning: Depart Pokhara by 7:00 AM via local jeep or bus to Nayapul (~1.5 hours, ~$2–3). Begin the trek from Nayapul toward Tikhedhunga. Trek through terraced farmland, rhododendron forests, and small Gurung villages. Distance: ~12 km, 4–5 hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Tikhedhunga (1,540m). Rest and explore the small village. Climb the famous stone staircase toward Ulleri if energy permits (optional short stretch).
day_by_day.evening: Settle into a budget teahouse in Tikhedhunga (~$2–5/night, often free with meal purchase). Socialize with fellow trekkers. Enjoy a warm meal and rest.

meals.breakfast: Eggs, toast, and tea at Pokhara guesthouse (~$2–3)
meals.lunch: Dal bhat or noodle soup at a teahouse in Hile or along the trail (~$4–5)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat at Tikhedhunga teahouse (~$5–6)

day_by_day.notes: October is peak trekking season — trails and teahouses will be busy. Book teahouses on arrival or ask ahead. Stay hydrated and pace yourself on the first trekking day. Altitude gain is gradual here.

day_by_day.morning: Early start from Tikhedhunga. Climb the steep stone staircase to Ulleri (2,080m) — approximately 3,000 steps, ~1.5 hours. Continue trekking through rhododendron and oak forests toward Ghorepani. Distance: ~12 km, 5–6 hours total.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Ghorepani (2,860m) by early afternoon. Check into a budget teahouse. Rest and acclimatize. Explore the village and interact with local Magar and Gurung people.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy panoramic Himalayan views from the village. Prepare for the early morning Poon Hill hike. Sleep early.

meals.breakfast: Porridge or pancakes at Tikhedhunga teahouse (~$3–4)
meals.lunch: Vegetable noodle soup or fried rice at a trail teahouse in Banthanti (~$4–5)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat with seasonal vegetables at Ghorepani teahouse (~$5–6)

day_by_day.notes: Ghorepani has several teahouses — compare prices before settling. Altitude increases significantly today; drink plenty of water and avoid alcohol. Poon Hill sunrise hike is tomorrow — set alarm for 4:30 AM.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up at 4:30 AM and hike to Poon Hill (3,210m) for sunrise (~45 minutes). Witness one of Nepal's most spectacular panoramas: Dhaulagiri, Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, Machhapuchhre, and more. Return to Ghorepani for breakfast. Then trek toward Tadapani through dense rhododendron forests. Distance: ~10 km, 4–5 hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Tadapani (2,630m). Rest and enjoy views of Annapurna South and Hiunchuli. Explore the small settlement.
day_by_day.evening: Relax at the teahouse. Journal, read, or stargaze. Early dinner and rest.

meals.breakfast: Eggs, toast, and hot lemon tea at Ghorepani teahouse (~$3–4)
meals.lunch: Packed lunch or stop at a trail teahouse between Ghorepani and Tadapani (~$4–5)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat or pasta at Tadapani teahouse (~$5–6)

day_by_day.notes: Poon Hill entry fee is ~$2 (NPR 200). The sunrise in October is usually crystal clear — bring a warm jacket as temperatures near the hilltop can drop to 0–5°C at dawn. The forest trail to Tadapani is beautiful and less crowded.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Tadapani toward Chhomrong, descending and ascending through forests and terraced fields. Pass through Gurjung village. Distance: ~10 km, 5–6 hours. Enjoy views of Annapurna South and Machhapuchhre (Fishtail) throughout.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Chhomrong (2,170m), the gateway to the Annapurna Sanctuary. Check into a teahouse. Explore the beautiful Gurung village with its traditional stone houses and terraced fields.
day_by_day.evening: Visit the Chhomrong Khola viewpoint. Attend a brief cultural interaction if organized by the teahouse. Rest and prepare for the deeper sanctuary trek ahead.

meals.breakfast: Oatmeal and tea at Tadapani teahouse (~$3)
meals.lunch: Dal bhat or noodle soup at Gurjung or a trail stop (~$4–5)
meals.dinner: Thakali dal bhat at Chhomrong teahouse (~$5–7)

day_by_day.notes: Chhomrong has ATMs and better-stocked shops — buy extra snacks, chocolate, and energy bars here as prices increase significantly further into the sanctuary. Confirm your teahouse bookings ahead if possible during peak season.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Chhomrong descending to Chhomrong Khola, then ascending steeply to Sinuwa (2,360m). Continue through bamboo and rhododendron forests to Bamboo (2,310m) and on toward Dovan. Distance: ~11 km, 5–6 hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Dovan (2,600m). Rest and enjoy the lush forested surroundings. The trail becomes narrower and more dramatic with waterfalls and dense vegetation.
day_by_day.evening: Settle into a basic teahouse at Dovan. Enjoy the peaceful forest atmosphere. Rest well as tomorrow involves significant altitude gain.

meals.breakfast: Pancakes and tea at Chhomrong teahouse (~$3–4)
meals.lunch: Noodle soup or fried rice at Bamboo teahouse (~$5–6)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat at Dovan teahouse (~$6–7)

day_by_day.notes: Note that prices increase as you ascend deeper into the sanctuary. Dal bhat remains the best value meal. Watch for leeches on the trail in bamboo forest sections — tuck trousers into socks. October weather should be dry and clear.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Dovan through Himalaya Hotel (2,920m) and continue to Hinku Cave and Deurali (3,230m). The trail passes through dramatic gorge scenery with towering walls. Distance: ~9 km, 4–5 hours. Watch for mountain views opening up as you ascend.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Deurali. Rest and acclimatize. Short optional walk around the area to aid acclimatization. The Annapurna massif begins to dominate the skyline.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the dramatic mountain scenery from Deurali. The temperature drops noticeably at this altitude. Warm up with hot drinks and rest early.

meals.breakfast: Porridge and hot lemon tea at Dovan (~$4)
meals.lunch: Garlic soup and noodles at Himalaya Hotel teahouse (~$6–7) — garlic helps with altitude
meals.dinner: Dal bhat or pasta at Deurali teahouse (~$7–8)

day_by_day.notes: Altitude sickness risk increases above 3,000m. Watch for symptoms: headache, nausea, dizziness, fatigue. Drink 3–4 liters of water daily. Eat garlic soup — it's a local remedy widely believed to aid acclimatization. Do not ascend if feeling unwell.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Deurali to Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) via Machhapuchhre Base Camp (MBC, 3,700m). The trail opens into the spectacular Annapurna Sanctuary — a natural amphitheater surrounded by towering peaks. Arrive at MBC and continue to ABC (4,130m). Distance: ~7 km, 4–5 hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Annapurna Base Camp — a truly iconic moment. Check into your boutique stay at the Annapurna Sanctuary accommodation. Rest and acclimatize. Take short walks around the base camp area to explore the surroundings.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the alpenglow on Annapurna I (8,091m), Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, Gangapurna, and Machhapuchhre as the sun sets. Stunning golden light on the peaks. Warm dinner and early rest.

meals.breakfast: Oatmeal, eggs, and tea at Deurali (~$4–5)
meals.lunch: Hot soup and bread at Machhapuchhre Base Camp (~$7–8)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat or pasta at ABC accommodation (~$8–10)

day_by_day.notes: This is the highlight of the entire trek. Take time to absorb the surroundings. Temperatures at ABC can drop to -5°C to -10°C at night in October — use all your layers. The boutique stay here is a relative comfort upgrade. Altitude is 4,130m — move slowly and stay hydrated.

day_by_day.morning: Wake before dawn (4:30–5:00 AM) to witness the sunrise over the Annapurna Sanctuary. The golden light illuminating the surrounding 7,000m and 8,000m peaks is absolutely breathtaking. Spend the morning exploring the base camp area and taking photos.
day_by_day.afternoon: Full acclimatization and exploration day at ABC. Take a short hike toward the glacier moraine for closer views of Annapurna I. Visit the memorial stones for mountaineers. Enjoy the rare silence and grandeur of the sanctuary.
day_by_day.evening: Final evening at Annapurna Base Camp. Reflect on the journey. Share stories with fellow trekkers. Watch stars emerge in the high-altitude sky — October offers exceptional stargazing conditions.

meals.breakfast: Eggs, toast, and hot chocolate or tea at ABC (~$5–6)
meals.lunch: Vegetable noodle soup and garlic bread at ABC teahouse (~$7–8)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat or pasta with seasonal vegetables at ABC accommodation (~$8–10)

day_by_day.notes: This is a rest and acclimatization day — do not push yourself. Mild altitude headaches are common; rest and hydration are the best remedies. Avoid sleeping pills as they suppress breathing at altitude. Carry a headlamp for the pre-dawn sunrise walk.

day_by_day.morning: Begin descent from ABC. Trek back down through MBC to Deurali and continue to Bamboo. The descent is significantly faster than the ascent. Distance: ~14 km, 5–6 hours descending. Enjoy the changing landscape as you drop in altitude.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Bamboo (2,310m). Rest at a teahouse. Notice how much easier breathing becomes as you descend. Explore the bamboo forest surroundings.
day_by_day.evening: Relax and celebrate completing the sanctuary trek. Enjoy a hearty meal. The lower altitude means better appetite and sleep quality.

meals.breakfast: Porridge and tea at ABC before departure (~$4–5)
meals.lunch: Dal bhat at Dovan or Himalaya Hotel teahouse (~$6–7)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat or noodles at Bamboo teahouse (~$5–6)

day_by_day.notes: Descents can be hard on knees — use trekking poles if available. Take your time on steep sections. The bamboo forest is beautiful on the way down — take time to appreciate it. Leeches are less active in October but remain cautious.

day_by_day.morning: Continue descent from Bamboo through Sinuwa back to Chhomrong. Enjoy the Gurung village atmosphere again. Distance: ~8 km, 3–4 hours. Stop at the Chhomrong viewpoint for final views of Annapurna South and Machhapuchhre.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking from Chhomrong to Jhinu Danda (1,760m). Jhinu Danda is famous for its natural hot springs on the Modi Khola riverbank — a perfect reward after days of trekking.
day_by_day.evening: Soak in the natural hot springs at Jhinu Danda (~$3 entry fee). The warm mineral waters are deeply relaxing for tired muscles. Return to teahouse for dinner and rest.

meals.breakfast: Eggs and toast at Bamboo teahouse (~$3–4)
meals.lunch: Dal bhat at Chhomrong teahouse (~$5–6)
meals.dinner: Thakali set meal at Jhinu Danda teahouse (~$5–6)

day_by_day.notes: The hot springs at Jhinu Danda are one of the best-kept secrets of the Annapurna trek. Go in the late afternoon for the most relaxing experience. Bring a change of clothes and a towel. The springs are a 20-minute walk from the main teahouse area.

day_by_day.morning: Final trekking day: Trek from Jhinu Danda to Nayapul via Siwai. Distance: ~10 km, 3–4 hours. The trail follows the Modi Khola valley through villages and farmland. Enjoy the final views of the Annapurna range.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Nayapul. Take a local jeep or bus back to Pokhara (~1.5 hours, ~$2–3). Check back into lakeside budget guesthouse. Shower, rest, and celebrate completing the trek. Visit Phewa Lake for a relaxing boat ride (~$5 for 1 hour).
day_by_day.evening: Celebration dinner at a Pokhara lakeside restaurant. Browse souvenir shops in Lakeside for gifts and mementos. Enjoy the lively atmosphere of Pokhara's tourist district.

meals.breakfast: Pancakes and tea at Jhinu Danda teahouse (~$3–4)
meals.lunch: Quick meal at Nayapul or snacks during the jeep ride (~$2–3)
meals.dinner: Celebration dinner — Thakali thali or wood-fired pizza at a lakeside restaurant (~$6–8)

day_by_day.notes: You've completed the Annapurna Sanctuary Trek — congratulations! Take time to rest your legs. Consider a massage in Pokhara (~$10–15/hour at a reputable spa) to recover. Book your bus back to Kathmandu for tomorrow morning.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Pokhara. Wake up for a peaceful sunrise view of the Annapurna range from the lakeside — a beautiful farewell to the mountains. Pack up and check out of guesthouse. Take a local bus or tourist bus back to Kathmandu (~7–8 hours, $5–8). Depart by 7:00–8:00 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive in Kathmandu by mid-afternoon. Check into a Thamel guesthouse (~$8–12). Visit Boudhanath Stupa (UNESCO World Heritage Site) or Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple) for a final cultural experience (~$2–3 entry). Browse Thamel for last-minute souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Final evening in Nepal. Enjoy a farewell dinner at a rooftop restaurant in Thamel. Reflect on the incredible 14-day journey through the Annapurna region. Pack for departure.

meals.breakfast: Full breakfast at Pokhara lakeside café — eggs, toast, fruit, coffee (~$4–5)
meals.lunch: Packed snacks or roadside dhaba stop during bus journey (~$2–3)
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at a Thamel rooftop restaurant — Nepali set meal or continental (~$6–10)

day_by_day.notes: Keep all trekking permits and receipts as souvenirs. Ensure passport, flight documents, and valuables are secured for departure. If your flight is the next day, confirm airport transfer arrangements. Thamel has 24-hour shops for any last-minute needs. Budget summary: Total estimated trip cost excluding flights is approximately $350–500 USD for 14 days including permits, accommodation, food, and local transport.

trip_options.title: Classic Annapurna, Nepal Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

hotel.name: Annapurna Sanctuary, Annapurna Conservation Area Boutique Stay

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu at 13:00 — clear immigration and collect luggage
day_by_day.afternoon: Transfer to your hotel in Pokhara or Kathmandu staging area (approximately 6–7 hour drive or 25-min domestic flight if pre-booked). Check in, freshen up, and take a gentle evening stroll around the lakeside area of Pokhara to acclimatize
day_by_day.evening: Relax at the hotel, review trek permits and gear checklist, light orientation walk around Lakeside Pokhara

meals.breakfast: Meal on flight
meals.lunch: Quick bite at airport café or roadside dal bhat stop en route
meals.dinner: Moondance Restaurant or Caffe Concerto, Pokhara Lakeside — try Nepali thali or pasta (mid-range, ~$8–12)

day_by_day.notes: Obtain ACAP (Annapurna Conservation Area Permit) and TIMS card today or first thing tomorrow morning in Pokhara before heading to the trailhead. Keep energy light — jet lag management is key.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning visit to the Pokhara Tourism Bureau to finalize ACAP and TIMS permits. Pack trekking bag and arrange transport to Nayapul (the trailhead, ~1.5 hours by jeep/taxi)
day_by_day.afternoon: Begin trek from Nayapul (1,070m) to Tikhedhunga (1,540m) — approximately 3–4 hours of moderate walking through terraced fields, river crossings, and traditional Gurung villages. Enjoy views of Hiunchuli and Annapurna South
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Tikhedhunga, check into a mid-range teahouse, shower and rest. Short walk around the village to watch local life at dusk

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast in Pokhara — eggs, toast, tea (~$4–6)
meals.lunch: Dal bhat at a local teahouse in Birethanti (~$5–7)
meals.dinner: Teahouse dinner in Tikhedhunga — vegetable curry, rice, and soup (~$6–8)

day_by_day.notes: October is peak trekking season in Annapurna — expect clear skies and vibrant rhododendron forests. Teahouses are plentiful but book ahead during peak season. Stay hydrated and wear layers.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Tikhedhunga to Ghorepani (2,860m) — a challenging but rewarding 5–6 hour ascent through dense rhododendron and oak forests, passing Ulleri (famous steep stone staircase of ~3,000 steps)
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Ghorepani by early afternoon. Rest and explore the charming hilltop village. Visit the small local market and interact with Magar and Gurung community members
day_by_day.evening: Sunset views of Dhaulagiri, Annapurna South, and Hiunchuli from Ghorepani village viewpoints. Cozy teahouse dinner and early to bed

meals.breakfast: Teahouse breakfast — porridge, eggs, and milk tea (~$4–5)
meals.lunch: Light snack and noodle soup at Ulleri teahouse (~$4–6)
meals.dinner: Teahouse dinner at Ghorepani — dal bhat set meal (~$7–9)

day_by_day.notes: The Ulleri staircase is steep — take it slow and use trekking poles. Ghorepani sits at nearly 2,900m; watch for early signs of altitude discomfort. Drink 3–4 liters of water today.

day_by_day.morning: Pre-dawn hike (depart 5:00 AM) to Poon Hill (3,210m) — one of the most iconic sunrise viewpoints in Nepal, offering a 180-degree panorama of the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges. Witness the golden alpenglow on Machhapuchhre (Fishtail Mountain)
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend back to Ghorepani for breakfast, then continue trekking toward Tadapani (2,630m) through rhododendron forests — approximately 4–5 hours of moderate trekking
day_by_day.evening: Arrive Tadapani, settle into teahouse. Enjoy sweeping views of Annapurna South and Hiunchuli. Journaling, stargazing, and rest

meals.breakfast: Hot tea and snacks at Poon Hill summit, full breakfast back at Ghorepani teahouse (~$5–7)
meals.lunch: Packed lunch or teahouse stop en route to Tadapani (~$5–6)
meals.dinner: Teahouse dinner at Tadapani — garlic soup, vegetable noodles, and apple pie (~$7–9)

day_by_day.notes: Poon Hill entry fee applies (~NPR 100). Bring a headlamp and warm layers for the pre-dawn hike. October mornings can be below freezing at this altitude. The rhododendron forests between Ghorepani and Tadapani are spectacular.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Tadapani to Chhomrong (2,170m) — approximately 5–6 hours descending through forests and crossing the Modi Khola river. Chhomrong is the gateway village to the Annapurna Sanctuary
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Chhomrong, check into a mid-range teahouse with views of Annapurna South and Hiunchuli. Explore the village's stone-paved lanes and visit the small local monastery
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy panoramic terrace views over Chhomrong village and the Modi Khola valley. Sunset photography session. Light stretching and muscle recovery

meals.breakfast: Teahouse breakfast at Tadapani — muesli, banana pancakes, and tea (~$5–6)
meals.lunch: Dal bhat at a teahouse en route (~$6–7)
meals.dinner: Chhomrong teahouse dinner — mixed vegetable curry, rice, and ginger lemon honey tea (~$7–10)

day_by_day.notes: Chhomrong has the last reliable charging points and good Wi-Fi before heading deeper into the sanctuary. Stock up on snacks, water purification tablets, and any medication needed. Notify your teahouse of your planned onward route.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Chhomrong to Dovan (2,600m) via Sinuwa and Bamboo — approximately 5–6 hours through bamboo forests, river gorges, and dramatic cliff paths. Pass through the Annapurna Conservation Area's dense subtropical jungle
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Dovan, check into teahouse. Rest legs and enjoy the serene forest atmosphere. Short nature walk near the teahouse to spot Himalayan birds and wildlife
day_by_day.evening: Early dinner and rest. The forest at Dovan is alive with sounds — listen to the rushing Modi Khola river and nocturnal wildlife

meals.breakfast: Teahouse breakfast at Chhomrong — eggs, toast, and milk tea (~$5–6)
meals.lunch: Noodle soup and snacks at Bamboo teahouse (~$5–7)
meals.dinner: Dovan teahouse — dal bhat and vegetable curry (~$7–9)

day_by_day.notes: The trail between Sinuwa and Bamboo involves significant descent and re-ascent — knee pads or trekking poles highly recommended. Leeches can be present in the bamboo forest section in humid conditions. Tuck in socks and use repellent.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Dovan to Machhapuchhre Base Camp (MBC, 3,700m) via Himalaya Hotel and Deurali — approximately 5–6 hours. The landscape transforms dramatically from forest to alpine meadows and glacial moraines
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at MBC by early afternoon. Rest and acclimatize — do not ascend further today. Walk around the base camp area to observe the towering Machhapuchhre (Fishtail) peak up close
day_by_day.evening: Stunning sunset from MBC with views of Annapurna I, Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, and Machhapuchhre. Early dinner and rest — tomorrow is the big push to Annapurna Base Camp

meals.breakfast: Dovan teahouse — porridge and hot chocolate (~$5–6)
meals.lunch: Hot soup and snacks at Himalaya Hotel teahouse (~$6–8)
meals.dinner: MBC teahouse — dal bhat, garlic soup, and herbal tea (~$8–11)

day_by_day.notes: Altitude increases significantly today (from 2,600m to 3,700m). Move slowly, drink plenty of water, and avoid alcohol. Headache or mild dizziness is common — rest is the cure. If symptoms worsen, descend immediately. Temperatures drop sharply at night — use all sleeping bag layers.

day_by_day.morning: Early start (6:00 AM) from MBC to Annapurna Base Camp (ABC, 4,130m) — approximately 2–3 hours through glacial terrain. Arrive at ABC and witness the extraordinary 360-degree amphitheater of the Annapurna Sanctuary surrounded by 7,000m+ peaks
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore ABC — walk around the sanctuary plateau, visit the memorial stones for mountaineers, and photograph the dramatic icefalls and glaciers. Rest and acclimatize at the highest point of your trek
day_by_day.evening: Sunset alpenglow on Annapurna I (8,091m), Annapurna South, Gangapurna, and Machhapuchhre — a once-in-a-lifetime spectacle. Celebrate reaching ABC with your trekking group or guide

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast at MBC before departure — toast and tea (~$4–5)
meals.lunch: Hot soup and snacks at ABC teahouse (~$7–9)
meals.dinner: ABC teahouse — full dal bhat set, hot chocolate, and apple pie (~$10–13)

day_by_day.notes: ABC sits at 4,130m — altitude sickness is a real risk. Move slowly, breathe deeply, and stay well-hydrated. Do not plan any strenuous activity this afternoon. The teahouses at ABC are basic but functional. Sleeping at this altitude can be difficult — this is normal.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise at ABC — one of the most breathtaking natural spectacles on Earth as the first light hits Annapurna I and the surrounding peaks. Final photography and reflection time at the sanctuary
day_by_day.afternoon: Begin descent from ABC back to Bamboo (2,310m) — a long but rewarding 6–7 hour descent retracing the route through MBC, Deurali, Himalaya Hotel, and Dovan to Bamboo
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Bamboo teahouse, rest tired legs. Celebrate the successful ABC summit with a warm dinner and well-deserved rest

meals.breakfast: ABC teahouse — eggs, porridge, and hot tea (~$6–8)
meals.lunch: Snacks and soup at Deurali or Himalaya Hotel teahouse (~$6–8)
meals.dinner: Bamboo teahouse — dal bhat and vegetable curry (~$7–9)

day_by_day.notes: Descent is hard on knees — use trekking poles and take your time. The altitude drop from 4,130m to 2,310m in one day is significant and you'll feel noticeably better by evening. Blisters are common at this stage — treat and dress them properly.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Bamboo to Jhinu Danda (1,780m) via Sinuwa and Chhomrong — approximately 5–6 hours. Jhinu Danda is famous for its natural hot springs along the Modi Khola river
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend to the natural hot spring pools at Jhinu Danda (20-minute steep trail from the village) — soak tired trekking muscles in the geothermal waters surrounded by lush forest and river sounds
day_by_day.evening: Return to Jhinu Danda teahouse, enjoy a relaxed dinner. Reflect on the journey and share stories with fellow trekkers

meals.breakfast: Bamboo teahouse — pancakes and milk tea (~$4–6)
meals.lunch: Dal bhat at Chhomrong teahouse (~$6–8)
meals.dinner: Jhinu Danda teahouse — mixed grill vegetables, rice, and lemon tea (~$7–9)

day_by_day.notes: The hot springs at Jhinu Danda are a beloved highlight of the Annapurna circuit — bring a towel and flip-flops. Entry fee applies (~NPR 200). The springs are most enjoyable in late afternoon when the air cools. This is a wonderful natural recovery day for muscles.

day_by_day.morning: Final trekking day — trek from Jhinu Danda back to Nayapul (1,070m) via Kimche and Birethanti — approximately 4–5 hours of pleasant downhill walking through terraced farmland and river valleys
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Nayapul and arrange jeep/taxi transfer back to Pokhara (1.5 hours). Check into a comfortable mid-range hotel in Lakeside Pokhara. Hot shower, laundry, and full relaxation
day_by_day.evening: Celebratory lakeside dinner in Pokhara with views of Phewa Lake. Treat yourself to a traditional Nepali cultural dinner show or live music at a lakeside restaurant

meals.breakfast: Jhinu Danda teahouse — full breakfast with eggs and coffee (~$5–7)
meals.lunch: Final trail lunch at Birethanti — dal bhat (~$6–7)
meals.dinner: Pokhara lakeside restaurant — Nepali set dinner with momo (dumplings), dal bhat, and local raksi or lemon soda (~$10–15)

day_by_day.notes: You have officially completed the Annapurna Sanctuary Trek — congratulations! Total trekking distance approximately 110–120km over 10 days. Arrange a traditional Nepali massage in Pokhara this evening for full recovery (~$15–20 for 60 minutes).

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery day in Pokhara. Sleep in, enjoy a leisurely breakfast by Phewa Lake. Optional: sunrise boat ride on Phewa Lake with views of Machhapuchhre and the Annapurna range reflected on the water
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the International Mountain Museum in Pokhara (one of the world's finest mountaineering museums) to learn about Himalayan expeditions and Nepali culture. Browse Lakeside market for trekking souvenirs, pashmina, and thangka paintings
day_by_day.evening: Sunset paragliding flight over Pokhara (optional, ~$80–100) for a bird's-eye view of the Himalayas and Phewa Lake. Alternatively, sunset viewing from the World Peace Pagoda across the lake

meals.breakfast: Lakeside café breakfast — avocado toast, fresh juice, and coffee (~$6–9)
meals.lunch: Pokhara restaurant — wood-fired pizza or pasta (~$8–12)
meals.dinner: Fine lakeside dining — Nepali-fusion cuisine at Caffe Concerto or Moondance (~$12–18)

day_by_day.notes: Pokhara is a wonderful rest stop with excellent cafés, yoga studios, and wellness centers. Consider booking a 90-minute full-body massage at one of the reputable Lakeside spas. The International Mountain Museum is open 9 AM–5 PM, entry ~$5.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Sarangkot (1,592m) — either hike up (2 hours) or take a taxi for sunrise views over the entire Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges. A peaceful final mountain morning with panoramic Himalayan views
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Pokhara and visit Devi's Falls (Patale Chhango) and Gupteshwor Cave — two fascinating natural geological wonders just outside town. Explore the Tibetan refugee camp at Tashiling for handicrafts and cultural insight
day_by_day.evening: Final evening in Pokhara — lakeside walk, souvenir shopping, and a farewell dinner. Arrange transport or domestic flight back to Kathmandu for the following morning

meals.breakfast: Sarangkot hilltop café — hot tea and snacks with mountain views (~$4–6)
meals.lunch: Pokhara local restaurant — thakali set meal (~$7–10)
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at a lakeside restaurant — Nepali BBQ or momo platter with local beer (~$10–15)

day_by_day.notes: Book your Pokhara-Kathmandu transport (domestic flight ~$100 or tourist bus ~$10–15) in advance as October is peak season. Devi's Falls and Gupteshwor Cave entry fee applies (~NPR 100 each). The Tibetan refugee camp has authentic handmade carpets and jewelry.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning transfer to Pokhara Airport for domestic flight to Kathmandu (25 minutes) or scenic tourist bus journey (6–7 hours). Arrive in Kathmandu and check into a mid-range hotel in Thamel
day_by_day.afternoon: Final Kathmandu exploration — visit Boudhanath Stupa (UNESCO World Heritage Site), one of the largest Buddhist stupas in the world. Walk the kora (circumambulation path) and visit the surrounding monasteries and cafés
day_by_day.evening: Final dinner in Kathmandu at a rooftop restaurant in Thamel with views of the city. Last-minute souvenir shopping in Thamel market for thangka art, singing bowls, and pashmina. Pack and prepare for departure

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast in Pokhara or airport café (~$5–7)
meals.lunch: Kathmandu café near Boudhanath — Tibetan butter tea, momos, and tsampa bread (~$7–10)
meals.dinner: Rooftop farewell dinner in Thamel — Nepali-continental fusion, local beer or lassi (~$12–18)

day_by_day.notes: Boudhanath Stupa entry fee applies (~NPR 400). Allow extra time for Kathmandu traffic when heading to the international airport. Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport at least 3 hours before international departure. Declare any purchased items over customs limits. Safe travels!

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Annapurna, Nepal Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

hotel.name: Annapurna Sanctuary, Annapurna Conservation Area Boutique Stay

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu at 13:00 — No morning activities scheduled due to flight arrival time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private luxury transfer from Kathmandu airport to your boutique stay in the Annapurna Conservation Area. En route, stop at a scenic viewpoint near Pokhara for panoramic Himalayan vistas. Check in, freshen up, and enjoy a welcome orientation with your personal trek guide over afternoon tea and local snacks.
day_by_day.evening: Settle into your boutique accommodation. Enjoy a curated welcome dinner on the property terrace with views of the surrounding peaks under the Himalayan night sky. Briefing session with your lead guide about the 14-day premium itinerary, gear check, and acclimatization protocols.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable (in-flight or airport)
meals.lunch: Light refreshments and artisan snacks provided during private transfer
meals.dinner: Welcome dinner at the boutique lodge — multi-course Nepali and continental fusion menu featuring dal bhat royale, yak cheese appetizers, and seasonal mountain vegetables paired with imported wines

day_by_day.notes: Ensure all trekking permits (ACAP and TIMS card) are pre-arranged by your luxury travel concierge. Hydrate well and rest to begin acclimatization. Altitude at base lodge is approximately 1,000–2,000m depending on entry point.

day_by_day.morning: Guided nature walk through the lower Annapurna Conservation Area forest trails. Spot diverse Himalayan birdlife including Danphe (Himalayan Monal, Nepal's national bird), eagles, and exotic pheasants. Your private naturalist guide will provide detailed ecological commentary.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a traditional Gurung village near the conservation area. Participate in an immersive cultural experience — observe local weaving, learn about Gurung shamanic traditions, and enjoy a private home-hosted tea ceremony with a local family.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the boutique lodge for a sunset yoga session on the private deck overlooking the Annapurna range led by a resident yoga instructor. Relaxing Himalayan herbal bath prepared by lodge staff.

meals.breakfast: Gourmet lodge breakfast — freshly baked bread, organic eggs, Himalayan honey, fresh fruit, Nepali butter tea or specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Picnic lunch prepared by the lodge chef, served at a scenic forest clearing — artisan sandwiches, local cheese, seasonal fruit, and herbal infusions
meals.dinner: Fine dining at the lodge — Gurung-inspired tasting menu with locally sourced ingredients, including gundruk soup, smoked yak tenderloin, and cardamom panna cotta

day_by_day.notes: Day 2 is intentionally light to allow for proper acclimatization. Avoid alcohol and strenuous exertion. Keep hydration levels high throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the first proper trekking day on the Annapurna Sanctuary trail. Guided hike through rhododendron and bamboo forests with breathtaking views of Machhapuchhre (Fishtail Mountain). Trek from the lower lodge toward Chomrong or equivalent altitude-appropriate checkpoint.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at a mid-trail luxury teahouse or private campsite set up by your support team. Enjoy a hot lunch with mountain panoramas. Afternoon leisure — explore the immediate surroundings, photograph the dramatic landscape, and rest.
day_by_day.evening: Campfire or lodge fireplace gathering with your guide team. Stargazing session with a portable high-powered telescope provided by your luxury operator. The October sky in the Himalayas offers extraordinary visibility of the Milky Way.

meals.breakfast: Hot lodge breakfast — porridge with Himalayan berries, omelette station, fresh juice, and Darjeeling tea
meals.lunch: Gourmet trail lunch at a scenic rest point — warm lentil soup, grilled paneer wraps, energy bars, and electrolyte drinks
meals.dinner: Elevated teahouse or camp dinner — slow-cooked Nepali lamb curry, sautéed mountain greens, steamed rice, and imported dessert wine

day_by_day.notes: Trekking distance approximately 8–12 km today. Elevation gain monitored closely by your private guide. Porter team handles all luggage. Emergency oxygen and first-aid kit carried at all times.

day_by_day.morning: Early sunrise hike to a nearby ridge for a spectacular panoramic view of Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, and Machhapuchhre at golden hour. Private photography session with a professional mountain photographer provided by your luxury operator.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking toward higher elevation camps. Pass through traditional stone-paved trails, suspension bridges, and terraced hillside villages. Your naturalist guide identifies medicinal alpine plants and explains the unique Himalayan ecosystem.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at the next premium lodge or luxury tented camp. Enjoy a hot stone massage from your accompanying wellness therapist to relieve muscle fatigue. Private dinner under a canopy of Himalayan stars.

meals.breakfast: Sunrise breakfast box — energy-packed items including nuts, dried fruits, protein bars, hard-boiled eggs, and thermos of specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Trail-side hot lunch prepared by your private cook — vegetable noodle soup, whole grain flatbread, and seasonal mountain tea
meals.dinner: Chef's special camp dinner — roasted chicken with herb jus, quinoa salad, steamed dumplings (momos), and chocolate fondant for dessert

day_by_day.notes: Professional mountain photographer accompanies the group today. All high-resolution images delivered digitally. Altitude increasing — monitor for any symptoms of altitude sickness (headache, nausea, dizziness).

day_by_day.morning: Acclimatization day — gentle morning hike to a higher elevation point and return to the same camp (classic 'climb high, sleep low' protocol). Explore the surrounding terrain with your guide at a relaxed pace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Wellness afternoon at camp — guided breathing and meditation session tailored for high-altitude environments. Option for a private journaling and reflection session with curated prompts provided by your luxury operator.
day_by_day.evening: Cultural evening — your guide hosts an intimate session on Himalayan history, Annapurna mythology, and the stories of legendary mountaineers who conquered these peaks. Warm drinks and premium snacks served fireside.

meals.breakfast: Full hot breakfast at camp — scrambled eggs, sautéed mushrooms, toast with local jam, fresh fruit platter, and herbal tea selection
meals.lunch: Light acclimatization lunch — miso soup, steamed vegetables, brown rice, and ginger lemon tea to aid altitude adjustment
meals.dinner: Comfort camp dinner — slow-cooked vegetable stew, garlic naan, spiced lentil dal, and warm apple crumble with cream

day_by_day.notes: Acclimatization is critical at this stage. No major elevation gain today. Wellness therapist on standby. Medical-grade pulse oximeters used to monitor blood oxygen levels for all guests.

day_by_day.morning: Resume trekking toward the Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) at 4,130m. The trail ascends through the Modi Khola valley with towering walls of the Annapurna massif on all sides — one of the most dramatic landscapes in the world.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Annapurna Base Camp. Take in the awe-inspiring 360-degree amphitheater of Himalayan giants — Annapurna I (8,091m), Annapurna South, Gangapurna, and Machhapuchhre. Private champagne toast at the base camp with your guide team.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at Annapurna Base Camp — witness the alpenglow painting the peaks in shades of gold, orange, and crimson. Premium lodge or luxury tented accommodation at ABC. Warm and hearty dinner to celebrate reaching the sanctuary.

meals.breakfast: High-energy pre-trek breakfast — oatmeal with nuts and honey, boiled eggs, banana, and electrolyte-enhanced water
meals.lunch: Packed gourmet lunch consumed at a scenic rest point on the ascent — smoked salmon wraps, energy balls, and hot soup in a thermos
meals.dinner: Celebration dinner at ABC — premium Himalayan feast with yak cheese fondue, spiced lamb rack, roasted potatoes, and a specially curated Himalayan dessert platter with imported sparkling wine

day_by_day.notes: Reaching ABC is a major milestone. Altitude at 4,130m — mandatory rest after arrival. No exertion beyond camp perimeter this evening. Oxygen supplementation available on request. Warmest trekking gear essential as temperatures drop significantly at night.

day_by_day.morning: Pre-dawn wake-up for the iconic Annapurna Base Camp sunrise — one of the most spectacular natural light shows on Earth. Watch the first rays of sunlight illuminate the summits of Annapurna I and surrounding peaks. Professional photography session.
day_by_day.afternoon: Exploration of the base camp area. Your guide narrates the history of legendary expeditions — the first ascent of Annapurna I in 1950 by Maurice Herzog. Afternoon rest and wellness session at the premium lodge.
day_by_day.evening: Begin descent toward Machapuchare Base Camp (MBC) or equivalent lower elevation camp for better rest and recovery. Enjoy a warm and nourishing dinner at the lower camp.

meals.breakfast: Sunrise breakfast at ABC — hot porridge, boiled eggs, toast, and premium Himalayan herbal tea served with panoramic mountain views
meals.lunch: Descending trail lunch — energy-rich snacks, hot soup, and herbal infusions consumed at a scenic viewpoint
meals.dinner: Hearty recovery dinner at lower camp — butter chicken, steamed basmati rice, roasted vegetables, and warm chocolate brownie with custard

day_by_day.notes: Descent begins today — descending is equally important and requires careful knee protection. Use trekking poles provided by your luxury operator. Altitude decreases improve oxygen levels and enhance sleep quality.

day_by_day.morning: Continue descent through the bamboo and rhododendron forest zone. Morning birdwatching session with your naturalist guide — the lower altitudes host a richer diversity of Himalayan bird species including sunbirds, laughingthrushes, and warblers.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at a mid-trail luxury lodge for a well-deserved rest day. Indulge in a full spa afternoon — deep tissue massage, Himalayan salt scrub, and reflexology session provided by your accompanying wellness therapist.
day_by_day.evening: Private cooking class with the lodge chef — learn to prepare authentic Nepali dishes including dal bhat, sel roti, and achar. Enjoy your culinary creations as dinner with your guide team in an intimate setting.

meals.breakfast: Full lodge breakfast — fresh fruit smoothie, eggs Benedict with Himalayan herbs, croissants, and Darjeeling first-flush tea
meals.lunch: Lodge garden lunch — grilled paneer salad, lentil soup, whole grain bread, and fresh lime soda
meals.dinner: Hands-on cooking class dinner — your own prepared Nepali feast with dal bhat, vegetable curry, pickled radish achar, and sel roti with honey

day_by_day.notes: Rest day with spa focus. Muscles should be recovering well. Rehydration is key — lodge provides filtered mineral water and electrolyte supplements. Review photographs from the trek with the professional photographer over evening tea.

day_by_day.morning: Trek to a scenic waterfall hidden within the conservation area — a private, lesser-known gem arranged exclusively by your luxury operator. Swim in the natural pool (weather permitting) or simply enjoy the pristine wilderness setting.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local organic farm within the conservation area. Learn about sustainable farming practices in the Himalayas, taste fresh-picked produce, and participate in a farm-to-table experience with the farmer's family.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the boutique lodge for a gala dinner — a premium multi-course meal prepared by a guest chef flown in from Kathmandu, featuring the finest Himalayan and continental ingredients.

meals.breakfast: Energizing breakfast — açaí bowl with granola, smoked yak cheese on toast, fresh orange juice, and specialty pour-over coffee
meals.lunch: Farm-fresh lunch at the organic farm — seasonal vegetable platter, freshly churned butter with flatbread, and herbal farm tea
meals.dinner: Gala lodge dinner — amuse-bouche, Himalayan trout ceviche, slow-roasted lamb with mountain herb crust, truffle risotto, and a decadent chocolate and cardamom tart with imported dessert wine

day_by_day.notes: Waterfall location is exclusive and accessed via a private trail arrangement. Farm visit is pre-coordinated with the local farming family. Gala dinner is a highlight of the trip — smart casual attire recommended.

day_by_day.morning: Guided hike to a high ridge viewpoint for a different perspective of the Annapurna massif. The October clear skies offer exceptional visibility — on a clear day, views extend to Dhaulagiri (8,167m) and beyond.
day_by_day.afternoon: Helicopter excursion over the Annapurna range — a premium aerial experience providing a bird's-eye view of the entire sanctuary, base camp, and surrounding glaciers. Approximately 45–60 minutes of flight time with a private pilot and commentary.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the boutique lodge. Relaxing evening with a private acoustic concert by a local Nepali musician performing traditional Gurung and Tamang folk music in the lodge's intimate lounge.

meals.breakfast: Pre-hike power breakfast — protein pancakes with Himalayan honey, fresh berries, smoked salmon, and green tea
meals.lunch: Gourmet picnic at the ridge viewpoint — charcuterie board, artisan cheeses, crackers, dried fruits, and chilled sparkling water
meals.dinner: Intimate lodge dinner — Tibetan-inspired menu featuring thukpa noodle soup, steamed momos with premium fillings, yak butter tea, and sweet rice pudding with saffron

day_by_day.notes: Helicopter excursion is weather-dependent. Backup date is Day 11 if weather is unfavorable. All flights are pre-booked with a premium Himalayan aviation operator. Safety briefing provided before departure.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise photography hike to a designated golden-hour viewpoint. Your professional photographer guides you through composition techniques to capture the perfect Himalayan landscape shots using both your personal camera and provided professional equipment.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Annapurna Conservation Area Project (ACAP) information center for an in-depth briefing on conservation efforts, wildlife protection, and sustainable tourism initiatives in the region. Meet with a local conservationist.
day_by_day.evening: Outdoor cinema experience at the lodge — watch a curated documentary about the first ascent of Annapurna I and Himalayan exploration under the stars, projected on a private outdoor screen with premium audio setup.

meals.breakfast: Sunrise breakfast box — thermos of specialty coffee, croissants, fruit, and energy bars consumed at the viewpoint
meals.lunch: Lodge garden lunch — Caesar salad with grilled chicken, focaccia bread, tomato bisque soup, and fresh lemonade
meals.dinner: Lodge chef's signature dinner — pan-seared Himalayan trout with herb butter, roasted root vegetables, quinoa pilaf, and a classic crème brûlée

day_by_day.notes: Photography session produces a professional print-quality photo album delivered to guests post-trip as a luxury keepsake. ACAP center visit includes a donation to conservation efforts included in the premium package.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day premium trekking excursion to a lesser-explored trail within the conservation area — a route curated exclusively for luxury guests, offering solitude and untouched Himalayan wilderness. Morning departure with a full support team.
day_by_day.afternoon: Reach the trail's highlight — a remote glacial lake or high-altitude meadow (Bugyals) carpeted with late-season alpine flowers. Private picnic lunch in this pristine setting. Optional meditation session guided by your wellness instructor.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the boutique lodge. Indulge in a premium Himalayan spa ritual — hot stone therapy, aromatic oil massage, and a private Himalayan salt bath. Quiet evening with personal reflection time.

meals.breakfast: Full lodge breakfast — eggs any style, smoked meats, pastries, fresh fruit platter, and premium tea selection
meals.lunch: Gourmet wilderness picnic — smoked salmon, artisan cheeses, whole grain crackers, fresh fruit, and premium hot chocolate in a thermos
meals.dinner: Intimate lodge dinner — Nepali royal thali with a premium selection of curries, pickles, breads, and desserts, paired with fine Indian wine

day_by_day.notes: This exclusive trail is not on standard trekking maps — arranged privately by your luxury operator. Full porter and guide support throughout. Emergency communication devices carried by the lead guide.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in the Annapurna Conservation Area — leisurely walk through the lodge gardens and immediate surroundings. Participate in a private gratitude and mindfulness session with your wellness instructor, reflecting on the transformative journey.
day_by_day.afternoon: Farewell interactions with local lodge staff, guides, and porters. Presentation of certificates of trek completion by your lead guide. Begin private luxury transfer back toward Pokhara for an optional lakeside afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive in Pokhara — enjoy a sunset dinner cruise on the serene Phewa Lake with panoramic reflections of the Annapurna and Machhapuchhre peaks on the water. Premium private boat arranged with a gourmet dinner service on board.

meals.breakfast: Farewell lodge breakfast — full spread of both Nepali and continental favorites, freshly baked goods, and a special farewell cake from the lodge kitchen team
meals.lunch: Light transition lunch during transfer — premium packed meal with sandwiches, fruit, and sparkling water
meals.dinner: Sunset lake cruise dinner on Phewa Lake — fresh grilled fish, Nepali mezze platter, imported wines, and a decadent dessert finale under the Himalayan twilight

day_by_day.notes: Farewell tips for guide and porter team are customary and deeply appreciated — your luxury operator provides guidance on appropriate amounts. Phewa Lake cruise is pre-booked and weather-secured with an indoor dining option as backup.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Pokhara — optional sunrise visit to the World Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa) overlooking Phewa Lake and the Annapurna range for a final, breathtaking farewell view of the mountains. Private vehicle and guide arranged.
day_by_day.afternoon: Leisure time in Pokhara — explore the Lakeside area, browse premium Nepali handicraft boutiques for curated souvenirs (pashmina, thangka paintings, handmade jewelry), or indulge in a final spa treatment at a luxury Pokhara hotel.
day_by_day.evening: Private luxury transfer to Pokhara Airport for onward connection to Kathmandu (or direct flight if available), and international departure. Your personal concierge ensures seamless airport assistance, premium lounge access, and a farewell gift hamper of Himalayan specialty products.

meals.breakfast: Farewell Pokhara breakfast at a premium lakeside restaurant — eggs Benedict, smoked salmon bagel, fresh juice, and specialty Nepali coffee with mountain views
meals.lunch: Farewell lunch at a top-rated Pokhara fine dining restaurant — curated Nepali and international menu with the best of what Pokhara's culinary scene offers
meals.dinner: In-flight dining or Kathmandu airport premium lounge — farewell Himalayan snack hamper provided by your luxury operator including artisan teas, local chocolates, and dried mountain fruits

day_by_day.notes: Farewell gift hamper includes: premium Himalayan tea collection, hand-rolled incense, a custom printed photo book of your 14-day journey, and a certificate of Annapurna Sanctuary Trek completion. Ensure all souvenirs comply with international customs regulations — your concierge provides a checklist.
